Release notes 4.2

Version 4.2 adds offline mode for the mobile apps and fixes the calendar sync bug that duplicated recurring events.

Offline mode keeps the last seven days of documents on the device and syncs changes when the connection returns.

HIDDEN-INLINE-STYLE should not appear
HIDDEN-STYLESHEET-CLASS should not appear

HIDDEN-VISIBILITY should not appear

HIDDEN-ATTRIBUTE should not appear
HIDDEN-ARIA should not appear

The calendar fix applies to Google and Microsoft calendars. Existing duplicates are removed on the first sync after updating.

Known issues

Attachments larger than 50 MB are not kept offline.
